arxiv-2104-01145.title: Cascades between light and heavy fermions in the normal state of magic angle twisted bilayer graphene
arxiv-2104-01145.creator: Jian Kang, B. Andrei Bernevig, Oskar Vafek
arxiv-2104-01145.description: Abstract We present a framework for understanding the recently observed cascade transitions and the Landau level degeneracies at every integer filling of twisted bilayer graphene. The Coulomb interaction projected onto narrow bands causes the charged excitations at an integer filling to disperse, forming new bands.

arxiv-2205-10527.title: Termination of Superradiance from a Binary Companion
arxiv-2205-10527.creator: Xi Tong, Yi Wang, Hui-Yu Zhu
arxiv-2205-10527.description: Abstract We study the impact of a binary companion on black hole superradiance at orbital frequencies away from the gravitational-collider-physics (GCP) resonance bands. A superradiant state can couple to a strongly absorptive state via the tidal perturbation of the companion, thereby acquiring a suppressed superradiance rate.

arxiv-2205-13584.title: Quantum Thermodynamics of a Quantum Sized AdS Black Hole
arxiv-2205-13584.creator: Behnam Pourhassan, Mahdi Atashi, Houcine Aounallah, Salman Sajad Wani, Mir Faizal, Barun Majumder*
arxiv-2205-13584.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the effects of non-perturbative quantum gravitational corrections on a quantum sized AdS black hole. It will be observed that these non-perturbative quantum gravitational corrections modify the stability of this black hole. We will use the non-equilibrium quantum thermodynamics to investigate the evaporation of this black hole between two states.

arxiv-2302-02290.title: Maximal k k -Edge-Connected Subgraphs in Weighted Graphs via Local Random Contraction
arxiv-2302-02290.creator: Chaitanya Nalam, Thatchaphol Saranurak
arxiv-2302-02290.description: Abstract The maximal k k -edge-connected subgraphs problem is a classical graph clustering problem studied since the 70’s. Surprisingly, no non-trivial technique for this problem in weighted graphs is known: a very straightforward recursive-mincut algorithm with Ω ⁡ ( m ​ n ) \Omega(mn) time has remained the fastest algorithm until now.

arxiv-2303-16889.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gergely Harcos, Jesse Thorner. Let π \pi and π ′ \pi^{\prime} be cuspidal automorphic representations of GL ⁡ ( n ) \mathrm{GL}(n) and GL ⁡ ( n ′ ) \mathrm{GL}(n^{\prime}) with unitary central characters. arxiv-2304-06757.title: Quantum Repeater for W States
arxiv-2304-06757.creator: Jorge Miguel-Ramiro, Ferran Riera-Sàbat, Wolfgang Dür
arxiv-2304-06757.description: Abstract W states are a valuable resource for various quantum information tasks, and several protocols to generate them have been proposed and implemented. We introduce a quantum repeater protocol to efficiently distribute three-qubit W W states over arbitrary distances in a 2D triangular quantum network with polylogarithmic overhead, thereby enabling these applications between remote parties.

arxiv-2305-08295.title: CLImage: Human-Annotated Datasets for Complementary-Label Learning
arxiv-2305-08295.creator: Hsiu-Hsuan Wang, Tan-Ha Mai, Nai-Xuan Ye, Wei-I Lin, Hsuan-Tien Lin
arxiv-2305-08295.description: Abstract Complementary-label learning (CLL) is a weakly-supervised learning paradigm that aims to train a multi-class classifier using only complementary labels, which indicate classes to which an instance does not belong. Despite numerous algorithmic proposals for CLL, their practical applicability remains unverified for two reasons.

arxiv-2305-18346.title: Attention Paper: How Generative AI Reshapes Digital Shadow Industry?
arxiv-2305-18346.creator: Qichao Wang Huan Ma, Wentao Wei, Hangyu Li, Liang Chen, Peilin Zhao, Binwen Zhao, Shu Zhang, Zibin Zheng, Bingzhe Wu
arxiv-2305-18346.description: Abstract The rapid development of digital economy has led to the emergence of various black and shadow internet industries, which pose potential risks that can be identified and managed through digital risk management (DRM) that uses different techniques such as machine learning and deep learning. The evolution of DRM architecture has been driven by changes in data forms.

arxiv-2308-04085.title: Deuterated Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons in the Interstellar Medium: The Aliphatic C–D Band Strengths DRAFT: August 8, 2026
arxiv-2308-04085.creator: X.J. Yang and Aigen Li
arxiv-2308-04085.description: Abstract Deuterium (D) was exclusively generated in the Big Bang and the standard Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) model predicts a primordial abundance of D/H ≈ \approx 26 parts per million (ppm). As the Galaxy evolves, D/H gradually decreases because of astration. The Galactic chemical evolution (GCE) model predicts a present-day abundance of D/H ≳ \gtrsim 20 ppm \,{\rm ppm} .

arxiv-2505-11901.title: Benchmarking LLMs in an Embodied Environment for Blue Team Threat Hunting
arxiv-2505-11901.creator: Xiaoqun Liu, Feiyang Yu, Xi Li, Guanhua Yan, Ping Yang, Zhaohan Xi
arxiv-2505-11901.description: Abstract As cyber threats continue to grow in scale and sophistication, blue team defenders increasingly require advanced tools to proactively detect and mitigate risks. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for enhancing threat analysis. However, their effectiveness in real-world blue team threat-hunting scenarios remains insufficiently explored.

arxiv-2505-14410.title: Pairwise Evaluation of Accent Similarity in Speech Synthesis
arxiv-2505-14410.creator: Jinzuomu, Suyuan, Dan, Korin
arxiv-2505-14410.description: Abstract Despite growing interest in generating high-fidelity accents, evaluating accent similarity in speech synthesis has been underexplored. We aim to enhance both subjective and objective evaluation methods for accent similarity. Subjectively, we refine the XAB listening test by adding components that achieve higher statistical significance with fewer listeners and lower costs.

pmc-10668929.title: High-resolution ultrasound in the evaluation of the adult hip
pmc-10668929.creator: Linda Probyn, Dyan Flores, Emma Rowbotham, Mark Cresswell, Angela Atinga
pmc-10668929.description: This paper reviews ultrasound of the hip, which is a commonly requested examination for symptomatic hip issues. This includes both intra-articular and extra-articular causes of hip pain. Ultrasound is easily accessible, lacks radiation exposure, and allows for evaluation of the contralateral hip as well as assessment of dynamic maneuvers. Ultrasound can be used to guide interventional procedures.

pmc-11360729.title: Study on the Relationship between Electron Transfer and Electrical Properties of XLPE/Modification SR under Polarity Reversal
pmc-11360729.creator: Zhi-Yuan Wu, Yu-Zhi Jin, Zhe-Xu Shi, Zhi-Yuan Wang, Wei Wang
pmc-11360729.description: The insulation of high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) cables experiences a short period of voltage polarity reversal when the power flow is adjusted, leading to sever field distortion in this situation. Consequently, improving the insulation performance of the composite insulation structure in these cables has become an urgent challenge.

pmc-11483648.title: The Causal Relationship between Immune-Mediated Inflammatory Diseases and Aortic Aneurysm: A Bidirectional Two-Sample Mendelian Randomization Study
pmc-11483648.creator: Sijia Sun, Jie Li, Mengxian Sun, Jie He, Songtao Tan, Ge Wang, Yuan Zheng, Xiaoping Fan
pmc-11483648.description: Methods We sourced genetic association data from public genome-wide association study databases for populations of European ancestry. Adhering to MR principles, we identified valid instrumental variables from genetic variants. A range of statistical methods were applied for MR analysis, with the inverse variance weighted (IVW) method emerging as the most reliable estimator of causality in this context.

pmc-11643620.title: The Impact of Complementary Feeding on Fecal Microbiota in Exclusively Breast-Fed Infants with Cystic Fibrosis (A Descriptive Study)
pmc-11643620.creator: Andrea Asensio-Grau, María Garriga, Saioa Vicente, Ana Andrés, Carmen Ribes-Koninckx, Joaquim Calvo-Lerma
pmc-11643620.description: Background/Objectives: Early life gut microbiota plays a pivotal role in shaping immunity, metabolism, and overall health outcomes. This is relevant in healthy infants but may be even more crucial in infants with chronic devastating diseases, such as cystic fibrosis (CF).

pmc-12619398.title: The clinical relevance of hyper-reflective foci in the inner retina at the diagnosis of multiple sclerosis
pmc-12619398.creator: Marco Puthenparampil, Alessandro Miscioscia, Elisa Basili, Valentina Annamaria Mauceri, Marta Pengo, Tommaso Torresin, Federica De Napoli, Elisabetta Pilotto, Francesca Rinaldi, Paola Perini, Edoardo Midena, Paolo Gallo
pmc-12619398.description: BackgroundHyper-Reflective foci (HRF) increased in the inner retina (IR) of patients with Multiple Sclerosis (pwMS).ObjectiveTo evaluate the risk of therapeutic failure, based on HRF count at baseline.MethodsFifty-seven pwMS were included in this retrospective, cohort, single-centre study. All patients were enrolled at clinical onset and were treatment-naive, with no evidence of optic nerve involvement.

pmc-12835916.title: Impact of Seropositivity on Mortality and Extra-Articular Manifestations in Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Nationwide Propensity-Matched Cohort Study
pmc-12835916.creator: Ahmad Alomari, Qusai Alqudah, Geran Maule, Aseed Mestarihi, Samah Al-Omari, Osama Obeidat, Reem Elmusa, Abdallah Rayyan, Omar Obeidat, Safwan Alomari, Diala Alawneh
pmc-12835916.description: Background/Objective.Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease that manifests as either seropositive or seronegative subtypes. Seropositive RA is often linked to more severe joint damage and systemic complications. In contrast, seronegative RA has a less defined clinical profile but may still present with significant comorbidities.

pmc-13425930.title: scZGA: a novel model based on ZINB distribution and graph attention for scRNA-seq data clustering
pmc-13425930.creator: Yansheng Kan, Yuling Liu, Jiacheng Pan, Ruochen Wang, Chen-Yu Zhang, Zhen Zhou
pmc-13425930.description: BackgroundIdentifying different cell types is a prerequisite step in the analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, with clustering being a common technique utilized for this purpose. However, high dropout rates inherent in scRNA-seq data and complex intercellular relationships become main challenges in scRNA-seq data analysis.

uslaw-usc-t29-s1193b.title: 29 U.S.C. § 1193b — Reporting and disclosure requirements
uslaw-usc-t29-s1193b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t29-s1193b.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 18 (Employee Retirement Income Security Program); Subchapter I (Protection Of Employee Benefit Rights); Part 8 (Pension-Linked Emergency Savings Accounts). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall— (1) prescribe such regulations as may be necessary to address reporting and disclosure requirements for pension-linked emergency savings accounts; and (2) seek to prevent unnecessary reporting and disclosure.
